name: runners-io
description: CI results and merge conflicts for your pull requests, read from GitHub with your own GitHub login and pushed into your Claude Code session as they happen (a Channels research preview). Claude chooses which pull requests to watch. Plus the runners.io MCP server for runners.io customers.

auto_subscribe.title: Watch the current branch's pull request automatically
auto_subscribe.description: pr: the channel watches the pull request for the branch your session's folder is on, without being asked (default). off: only the pull requests Claude subscribes to.
